data.name: Aalam
data.gender_notes: Aalam is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root word 'alamah', meaning 'to inform, to show, or to announce'. In the Islamic context, Aalam refers to the concept of the universe as a manifestation of Allah's infinite wisdom and power. The name Aalam carries the meaning “World” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aalam usually hope their child will grow to embody world and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of the vastness and complexity of Allah's creation, inspiring awe and gratitude.
data.etymology: Aalam belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “World.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aalam total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: عالم
in_arabic.meaning: العالم تعني الشخص الذي يعلم الكثير و هو عالم بالعلم و الفن
in_arabic.long_meaning: العالم اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و يعني الشخص الذي يعلم الكثير و هو عالم بالعلم و الفن, ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع مثل سورة آل عمران الآية 18 و سورة الإسراء الآية 36, و هو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني العلم و الرفعة

in_urdu.name: عالم
in_urdu.meaning: عالم کا مطلب ہے علم رکھنے والا شخص
in_urdu.long_meaning: عالم ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے, اس کا مطلب ہے علم رکھنے والا شخص یا عالم بالعلم و الفن, یہ نام قرآن کریم میں بھی ذکر ہوا ہے جیسے سورہ آل عمران آیت 18 و سورہ الإسراء آیت 36, یہ نام علم و حکمت کے مفہوم کو ظاہر کرتا ہے

in_hindi.name: आलम
in_hindi.meaning: आलम का अर्थ है ज्ञान रखने वाला व्यक्ति
in_hindi.long_meaning: आलम एक पुल्लिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से आया है, इसका अर्थ है ज्ञान रखने वाला व्यक्ति या विद्वान, यह नाम कुरआन में भी आया है जैसे सूरह آل عمران आयत 18 और सूरह इस्राइल आयत 36, यह नाम ज्ञान और बुद्धिमत्ता के अर्थ को दर्शाता है

in_pashto.name: عالم
in_pashto.meaning: عالم دى د علم لرونکی شخص مانا
in_pashto.long_meaning: عالم دى يو مذکر نوم دى چى د عربي ژبى څخه يې اخستى دى, دى نوم د علم لرونکی شخص يا عالم بالعلم و الفن مانا ورکوي, دى نوم په قرآن کريم کى هم ذکر شوى دى جیسے سورہ آل عمران آیت 18 و سورہ الإسراء آیت 36, دى نوم د علم او حکمت د مفهوم څرګندوي

in_english.name: Aalam
in_english.meaning: Aalam means knowledgeable person, scholar or learned individual
in_english.long_meaning: Aalam is a masculine given name of Arabic origin, meaning knowledgeable person, scholar or learned individual. It is derived from the Arabic root 'A-L-M' which signifies knowledge. The name Aalam appears in the Quran in several places, such as Surah Al Imran verse 18 and Surah Al Isra verse 36. It symbolizes wisdom, intellect, and spiritual insight. The name conveys a sense of respect and dignity associated with scholarly pursuits and spiritual growth

data.cultural_impact: The name Aalam carries a rich cultural significance as it is often associated with grandeur and magnificence. In Islamic literature and art, the term 'alam' is used to describe the vast expanse of the universe and the idea of its infinite beauty and complexity.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Aalam signifies the belief that the entire universe is a divine manifestation of Allah's presence and wisdom. The name serves as a powerful reminder of the interconnectedness of all things and the boundless nature of Allah's power and knowledge. Additionally, the root word 'alamah' also conveys the idea of guidance and revelation, emphasizing the importance of seeking knowledge and understanding in one's search for truth and meaning in life.
